I'm so sick of hearing the typical "Gaming culture is so toxic," and I think I figured out why it's used so much Face it, we're low hanging fruit to SJWs. We're shy, reclusive, harmless geeks. Sure, we might have a bark on social media, and even some bite, but we're nothing compared to other fanbases. And I think that's why they go after us:

We're relatively harmless.

And we're generally a white heterosexual male space, which is a big target for them.

I was thinking about what non-toxic fanbases they were comparing us to, and it dawned me that there are none. They don't have any to compare us to, and anything they'd pick would be just as toxic, if not more. I'm going to throw some big ones out there: K-Pop (not a chance, that's not a Twitter army, that's a Twitter swarm), literally any major league sport (have you seen what fans do when they win a championship?), Harry Potter, what else...

So why do you think that almost every major fanbase has become so rabid? My guess, social media has escalated it. It's brought us all together and riled us up. If you immerse yourself in any kind of fandom long enough, you become just as fanatical. And this is why it's so easy for SJWs to call us toxic – we've mobilized against the bullshit and we're loud about it.

I want to conclude my thoughts with three main points:

They go after us because they think we're easy.

They call us toxic, but they have nothing to compare us to, because the internet has made most fandom communities toxic.

Call them out on it. Ask them "Name one big community you like that isn't toxic" and see if they can respond. You'll always have the exception to the rule; someone may have a checkmate. But I'm betting most won't.

Daily Devotional

June 6

28 Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding. 29 He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength. (Isaiah 40:28-29 KJV)

God’s strength and power are infinite, as is His understanding. Can you imagine the power that it took to create the worlds and heavens (Genesis 1)? We can not begin to understand the power that our God has. Not only has God given us, His children, salvation, but He has put the whole Godhead in all those that have been born again (John 3:3) and have the Holy Ghost (Luke 24:49), so that we can have access to the very power that God has, if we can just tap into the Spirit realm, and get it.

If the Christian just could realize what we have in our New Spirits, we would be able to overcome anything that the Devil sends our way (John 10:10), and could live the victorious life that God intended for us to live. The average Christian has no idea what he has in his spirit, and therefore never is able to take advantage of the Gifts that our Father has given us (Ephesians 1:3). We need to let the Word of God take root in our hearts, and learn what we have been given and how to tap into it. Can you imagine the power available through acknowledging what we have in our spirits (Philemon 1:6)? Study the Word, and learn all about it. Praise God for giving us, His children, so very much.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
